hard_bans: exact architecture nodes, code, UI labels, ports and numbers cannot be produced by raster image generation
formula symbols and derivations must be typeset or kept in an editable whiteboard source
generated illustration cannot be presented as a screenshot, experiment result, official page or documentary evidence
no media generation or download before director-material-plan and assets approval

defaults.safe_area: center 80%; keep subtitles and labels out of top/bottom UI zones

formula_derivation.purpose: 公式、推导、证明和 Q/K/V 计算

architecture_diagram.primary: cs-board-whiteboard or beautiful-mermaid chosen by narrative need

evidence_screen_recording.purpose: 真实产品、官方页面、仓库、终端和实验结果

data_chart.purpose: 有绑定数据的比较、趋势、指标和排行

infographic_summary.purpose: 步骤、清单、路线图和章节总结

concept_illustration.purpose: 不承载精确事实的封面、隐喻、氛围和概念场景
concept_illustration.text_policy: generated-scene-text-free; all Chinese labels belong to Remotion/HTML
concept_illustration.text_review: human review must confirm that the image contains no text, letters, digits, logos or watermarks
concept_illustration.placeholder_policy: planning-only; block production until exported and reviewed

xiaohei_illustration.purpose: X•超玩手绘正文插画：把一个认知锚点转成单张可传播的怪诞解释图
xiaohei_illustration.text_policy: generated-scene-text-free; all Chinese labels belong to Remotion/HTML
xiaohei_illustration.text_review: human review must confirm the Xiaohei style and absence of text, letters, digits, logos and watermarks
xiaohei_illustration.placeholder_policy: planning-only; block production until exported and reviewed

cs_board_whiteboard.purpose: 连续白板叙事、字幕同步、分区揭示和手绘笔迹
cs_board_whiteboard.text_policy: labels must come from the human-authored source image or annotation; never use raster generation for exact UI, code or evidence
cs_board_whiteboard.source_contract: source image and same-image annotation JSON with integer pixel regions
cs_board_whiteboard.delivery_contract: Remotion owns 9:16 reframe, captions and final composition

xiaohei_scene.text_review: human review must confirm the Xiaohei style and absence of text, letters, digits, logos and watermarks
xiaohei_scene.placeholder_policy: planning-only; block production until exported and reviewed

designed_card.purpose: 一条短结论或转场卡片
